notes.title: 📰 Steam Next Fest Announcement – RAVENRIDGE
notes.content:
📰 Steam Next Fest Announcement – RAVENRIDGE[hr][/hr]
🎮 RAVENRIDGE Demo Now Live – Enter the Experiment

We are excited to announce that the demo for RAVENRIDGE is now live as part of Steam Next Fest!

Step into the decaying ruins of an abandoned prison, unravel the experiments buried beneath, and face a system that was never shut down.
You play as Ethan Ward, a troubled private investigator drawn into a psychological spiral of surveillance, control, and forgotten memories.
[hr][/hr]
🧠 What to Expect:

An atmospheric, story-driven psychological horror

30–45 minutes of intense gameplay

No combat. Just you, your mind, and what’s left of it

Multiple floors, each more unstable than the last

Strange figures… always watching
[hr][/hr]
💡 If you enjoy games like SOMA, Signalis, or Observer, this might be the next descent you’re looking for.
[hr][/hr]
🔗 Play the Demo Now:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734540/RAVENRIDGE/"][/dynamiclink]



🕯️ The system is watching.
The question is—are you the subject, or the observer?
